bad.title: Each Move costs 1.2 s of sliding
bad.text: 600 ms up and 600 ms down, so four emails spend almost 5 s on the sheet.

bad.title: The clock mostly counts waiting
bad.text: Much of the time on it is the sheet moving, not people deciding.

bad.title: A quick second click is lost
bad.text: Nothing happens, so people click again and wonder if the app froze.
bad.wait: Press Move twice quickly to see this.

good.title: Open before the pointer arrives
good.text: At 180 ms the sheet is up before people reach Archive.

good.title: The clock counts only people
good.text: With nothing to wait for, the time is just how fast they click.

bad.title: Add pulses all the time
bad.text: It throbs before anyone has done anything, so its motion means nothing.

bad.title: The title wiggles on every change
bad.text: Groceries didn’t change, but it moves as if it did.

bad.title: All the rows jump at once
bad.text: Milk lands between Eggs and Rice, and people can’t spot which row is new.

good.title: Add sits still
good.text: It only needs to look pressable, not to call for attention.

good.title: The other rows stay put
good.text: Apples, Bread and the rest don’t move, so the eye goes to the change.

good.title: Milk slides in where it lands
good.text: A short slide and a fading highlight show where the new item went.

bad.title: The person asked for less motion
bad.text: Reduce motion is on, and the app plays its biggest movement anyway.

bad.title: A tap grows the card to full screen
bad.text: Casa Azul scales up from its card over half a second, the kind of move that makes people dizzy.

bad.title: Back plays the zoom in reverse
bad.text: Every hotel people look at costs two big movements, one in and one out.
bad.wait: Open a hotel to see this.

good.title: The setting is respected
good.text: Reduce motion is on, so the zoom goes and only a fade is left.

good.title: Same tap, same hotel page
good.text: Casa Azul still opens, so nothing is lost but the movement.

good.title: Back fades out in 150 ms
good.text: Going back is as calm as going in, and focus returns to the card.
good.wait: Open a hotel to see this.

bad.title: Show queue seems slow to answer
bad.text: Ease-in starts slow, so right after the tap it looks like nothing happened.

bad.title: Both curves face the wrong way
bad.text: Ease-out on close ends slowly, so the queue lingers after people are done with it.

good.title: The queue answers the tap at once
good.text: Ease-out moves fast first, then settles into place.

good.title: Each curve suits its direction
good.text: Ease-in on close starts gently, then gets out of the way fast.

bad.title: A long title runs out of the card
bad.text: The planning meeting won’t fit on one line, and the design has no plan for it.
bad.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

bad.title: “Where:” with nothing after it
bad.text: The 11:45 call has no place, so the label points at empty space.
bad.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

bad.title: 24 guests, 24 dots
bad.text: The guest row was drawn for two faces, so it spills past the card.
bad.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

good.title: Long titles wrap to two lines
good.text: The card grows a little, and the meeting name stays readable.
good.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

good.title: No place, no “Where:” line
good.text: The call simply skips the line instead of showing an empty label.
good.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

good.title: Three faces and +21
good.text: Big guest lists show three avatars and a count, so the row always fits.
good.wait: Press Load real events to see this.

bad.title: Three names, one look
bad.text: Every line is cut before the month, the only part that differs.

bad.title: A guess attaches the wrong report
bad.text: People pick by position and find out only after it’s attached.
bad.wait: Pick the first file to see this.

good.title: The month always shows
good.text: The cut moves to the middle, so April.pdf stays whole.

good.title: The full name on hover and focus
good.text: Tabbing to a file shows it too, so the month is never a guess.
good.wait: Hover over a file to see this.

bad.title: Book jumps down a row
bad.text: When the ad arrives 1 s after Reload, Hotel Mar’s Book takes this spot.

bad.title: No space held for the ad
bad.text: While loading, the list starts with Casa Azul, so everything slides when the ad lands.

bad.title: The booking goes to the ad
bad.text: A fast tap books Hotel Mar at €112, not Casa Azul at €84.

good.title: Book stays under the pointer
good.text: Casa Azul’s button never moves, so a fast tap books the €84 room.

good.title: The ad’s row is held from the start
good.text: While it loads, a gray skeleton of the same height keeps its place.

bad.title: Seven digits with no breaks
bad.text: People have to count the digits to see it’s over a million.

bad.title: “null” where the bio should be
bad.text: An empty field reads like a crash, and people wonder what broke.

bad.title: A database timestamp for a join date
bad.text: People only need a month and a year, not the second it happened.

good.title: 1.2M, exact count one press away
good.text: The short form reads at a glance, and pressing it shows 1,234,567.

good.title: “No bio yet” instead of null
good.text: It tells people nothing is broken. The artist just hasn’t written one.

good.title: March 2023 is enough
good.text: The month and year say how long the artist has been here.

bad.title: Tab moves, but nothing shows it
bad.text: Focus passes Forward and lands on Archive with no ring, so Enter is a guess.

bad.title: The message can vanish by surprise
bad.text: If Enter lands on Archive or Delete, Sam’s message leaves the inbox.

good.title: Tab shows a tinted ring
good.text: A blue outline and a soft fill mark the button Enter will press.

good.title: No ring after a mouse click
good.text: Clicking Reply leaves it plain, so the ring shows only for people on the keyboard.

bad.title: Name on card comes second for Tab
bad.text: It sits at the bottom, so focus skips Expiry and CVC on the way down.

bad.title: Expiry comes last, going back up
bad.text: After CVC, focus jumps up and left, against the way people read.

good.title: Name on card is fourth both ways
good.text: It comes after CVC on screen and for Tab, so no field gets skipped.

good.title: Expiry follows the card number
good.text: Tab goes left to right, then down, the way people read the form.

bad.title: Tab goes right past it
bad.text: After Quantity, focus leaves the demo, so the shirt can’t be added from the keyboard.

bad.title: Bag (0) for people on a keyboard
bad.text: Enter does nothing here, and screen readers don’t call it a button.

good.title: Tab stops on Add to cart
good.text: It comes right after Quantity, and Enter or Space adds the shirt.

good.title: Bag (1) from the keyboard too
good.text: The button brings focus, the keys and its role with no extra code.

bad.title: Tab walks the page behind it
bad.text: Focus goes on to Add to album and Details, buttons people can’t even see.
bad.wait: Press Delete photo to see this.

bad.title: Closing drops focus on Menu
bad.text: After Cancel, people tab back down from the top to find their place.

good.title: Focus starts on Cancel
good.text: Tab moves only between Cancel and Delete while the dialog is open.
good.wait: Press Delete photo to see this.

good.title: Focus returns to Delete photo
good.text: After Escape or Cancel, people carry on from the button they used.
